number_rules.tokens: a number is any match of -?\d[\d,]*(\.\d+)?%? in prose and table cells
structural: dataset names FD001-FD004 and N-CMAPSS / C-MAPSS
phase labels: 'Phase N', 'Phase Nb', 'N.' and 'Nb.' at the start of a progress-table cell, and phase ranges like 0-9
version strings: v1.0.0, Python 3.12/3.13/3.14, package versions
anything inside fenced code blocks, inline code spans, URLs, link targets, image paths, HTML attributes and Mermaid diagrams
the README's time budgets (30 seconds, 2 minutes, 3 minutes, 10 minutes)
number_rules.allowed_values: every numeric leaf of the results files listed in writeup/facts.py SOURCES and every value of dashboards/snapshots/facts.json, re-read directly by the verifier; derived values only from the formulas in derived below

derived.fixed_vs_predictive_wasted_life_ratio: wasted cycles, fixed interval / wasted cycles, predictive (Phase 6 pooled)
derived.failures_avoided_vs_fixed: unplanned failures, fixed interval - predictive (Phase 6 pooled)
derived.failures_avoided_vs_rtf: unplanned failures, run to failure - predictive (Phase 6 pooled)
derived.percent_forms: a share x shown as 100x with the % sign
derived.absolute_gaps: the absolute value of a signed gap when the text says which side is better

number_rules.match: a displayed token matches a value if it equals the value rounded to the token's number of decimals (percent tokens compare 100 x value)

terms: wasted life|life wasted|useful life thrown away|cycles of (useful )?life
simulated.exempt: Markdown heading lines (the repository name contains OEE); the section under a heading still has to comply

misses: Phase 7 drift false-alarm rate on clean test runs with the 5% target, stated as not met
Phase 7b criterion C1 on FD004 with both fleet rates and the 5% limit, stated as failed

limitations.simulated plant: the OEE layer is a simulated plant, not measured production data
limitations.FD004: monitoring failed its pre-registered false-alarm criterion on FD004
limitations.N-CMAPSS: a fault-mode-aware drift reference needs unseen data such as N-CMAPSS to confirm
limitations.censor: once maintenance acts, failure labels are censored, so labels-only monitoring is biased
limitations.cost: no real cost data: impact is in counts and hours, not money

links.extracted: Markdown links and images, and bare http(s) URLs outside code; reference-style links resolved

exceptions.reason: LinkedIn answers automated clients with HTTP 999 (anti-bot), so a status check cannot pass for any LinkedIn URL
exceptions.rule: the URL must equal author.linkedin exactly

app.home_page: app/views/home.py, first in navigation: pitch, KPI tiles from dashboards/snapshots/facts.json, a 60-second guide to the pages, links to the repo, the case study and LinkedIn
app.every_page: one-sentence business question as subtitle, 'Simulated' badge where plant/OEE data appears, consistent number formats, a 'What this shows / why it matters' expander
app.sidebar_footer: author, links, NASA C-MAPSS credit, short snapshot checksum
app.verified_by: the Phase 8 verifier (every Home number recomputed independently); the Phase 8 scorecard must still pass
app.deploy: Streamlit Community Cloud from main, URL unchanged

release.description: Predictive maintenance on NASA turbofan data: LSTM remaining-life forecasts, CP-SAT crew scheduling, simulated OEE, Prefect monitoring, Streamlit + Power BI
release.notes: docs/RELEASE_NOTES.md rendered from the facts: headline results, live app link, docs links

career_materials.rule: every number from writeup.facts output; OEE numbers marked simulated

never_claim: the repository never states a total score such as '10/10'; the generated scorecard speaks for itself
